hints.text: Each letter has its own number. Be careful to put the right number with the right letter.
With $a = 3$ and $b = 5$ you get $2(3) + 5$. Do the multiplication before the addition.

explanation: Substitute the given values, $3$ for $a$ and $5$ for $b$: $2(3) + 5$.
Multiply first, because $2a$ means $2$ times $a$, which gives $2 \times 3 = 6$.
Add the value of $b$ to finish: $6 + 5 = 11$.
The value of the expression is $11$ when $a = 3$ and $b = 5$.
